summary: Solid 2.0 is a declarative JavaScript UI library that delivers fine‑grained reactivity with zero‑runtime overhead. It is built in TypeScript and can run in browsers, Node.js, or via server‑side rendering. Developers looking for a lightweight alternative to React or Vue will benefit from its faster render times and active contributor base. Its main strength is measurable performance gains (≈17% faster than React), while the low test pass rate (20%) suggests some usability issues.
